mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing inactivation of norepinephrine; hydrochlorothiazide can cause hypokalemia and may potentiate sympathomimetic effects, creating risk of hypertensive crisis and cardiac complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with careful blood pressure monitoring and ensure adequate potassium supplementation.
